CODEC-199.label: I
CODEC-199.reason: This is in the same broad `org.apache.commons.codec` library, but it targets a different subsystem (`Soundex` phonetic encoding vs `Base32` binary/text encoding). The mechanism is unrelated: Soundex is about character-to-code mapping rules in a phonetic algorithm, while the current failure is about Base32 hex decode-table validation and padding character allowance (`'W'`). There’s only very weak architectural proximity, so it provides little diagnostic value for localizing the Base32 bug.
